entries.description: Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, session-set-authoring-guide.md, ai-led-session-workflow.md, and the vba-symbol-db verdict + change-log + comprehension-packet for context.

Authored ai-assignment.md via routed analysis (gemini-pro). Recommended orchestrator for Session 1: Claude Opus 4.7 @ effort=high (current). Session 2 recommendation: split between in-IDE orchestrators per the spec's cross-provider design.

Authored CrossModuleResolutionTests.cs in tests/AccessHarvester.SymbolDb.Tests/. 5 hermetic tests. On unfixed code: 3 fail (GetString/StringFormat/sCompanyDelete_CompanyTypeChange unresolved with reason 'not-in-scope'); 2 pass (within-module CompanyIsActive binds, out-of-scope IsFormOpen stays unresolved).

Fixed AccessHarvester.Vba.Resolver.References.ReferenceResolver: added Step 1.5 cross-module Public lookup (TryResolveAcrossModules + IsPublicVisible). Walks ProjectScope.Children for sibling Standard ModuleScopes, matches Public declarations and Public-enum-member spillover by case-insensitive name. Form/Report/Class modules excluded (those host class members, not bare-callable functions). Also extended FqnResolver.DeclarationFqn to mint FQNs for EnumMemberDeclaration via ContainingEnum.Scope (members carry no Scope back-pointer).

Added end-to-end persistence test (RebuiltSymbolDb_PersistsResolvedCrossModuleReferences) that builds the canonical fixture, writes to a temp SQLite DB via SymbolDbWriter, and asserts the [References] table rows for GetString/StringFormat/sCompanyDelete_CompanyTypeChange resolve correctly. Did NOT overwrite tools/symbol-db/symbol-db.sqlite — the committed DB carries vba-symbol-db Sessions 4-7 interpretation columns and the spec's Open Question flags committing a rebuilt DB as a human decision. Surfaced as a deferred decision to the human in the close-out report.

Adjacent regression tests included in CrossModuleResolutionTests: WithinModule_CompanyIsActive_StillBinds (no within-module regression), OutOfFixtureScope_IsFormOpen_RemainsUnresolved (true unresolved still gets reason 'not-in-scope', no spurious cross-module bind). Plus the persistence-level test above.

dotnet build AccessHarvester.sln: 0 errors, 4 NU1903/preview warnings (pre-existing). dotnet test AccessHarvester.sln --no-build: 1600 passed, 3 skipped (non-Windows/Access-not-installed), 0 failed. SymbolDb tests went 69 -> 70 (CrossModuleResolutionTests added 6 facts). Resolver tests still all 400 green (no regression on the existing scope-chain path).
Cross-provider session verification (round 1) routed to gpt-5-4. Output saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.
